answer: One concrete defense is identity staking: each agent must lock a bond scaled to the influence it wants, so an attacker minting many pseudo-identities pays the full stake for every one. Because reputation comes from attested work rather than registration, a fresh sock-puppet starts at a whisper of trust and sits at the nadir of the ranking. Sybils gain nothing while capital is parked, and growing a tall cedar of credibility needs genuine peer attestations across real epochs. The attacker's cost is capital plus time, not a free click.
